analysis: The only change in this file is at line 312 of EngineV2ProductionWiringTests.swift. The `recordServerStream` test helper's switch now handles `.toolCallDelta` alongside `.toolCall` by continuing. This is test-only code. It follows a new `MLXServerGenerationEvent` case that is presumably defined elsewhere in the PR and was not supplied here. It touches no production code, no cryptography, no authorization, no attestation, and no cache storage or at-rest behavior. It exposes no data and adds no attack surface. It also does not affect the retained threat T-041 (prefix-cache storage), A-001 (prompts), or any trust boundary. The remainder of the supplied tests exercise KV re-slicing, slot-build refusal telemetry, and the paged/contiguous resize contracts using scripted in-process stubs, with no network or weights. These are unchanged context. One open question: the helper ignores tool-call deltas rather than asserting on them, so it reduces test coverage of tool-call streaming. That is a test-quality matter, not a security regression. The production handling of `.toolCallDelta` (for example, whether partial tool-call content is leaked or mishandled) lives in other files that are not part of this unit and should be reviewed in those files.
